title: Capt. Brian Sawyer

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Capt. Brian Sawyer invites you to come fish the Nature Coast on fly or light tackle for an epic journey in the skinny waters located here in Homosassa, Florida. Homosassa is home to sight fishing for redfish, snook, sea trout, flounder, black drum, and many other popular gamefish that make Florida the “Fishing Capital of the World”. In addition we offer seasonal Homosassa Tarpon fishing and Crystal River Tarpon Fishing. We also target Tarpon seasonally, and during that season - as a priority in our service lineup. We specialize in fishing for Tarpon on fly tackle, but we can also cater trips to meet your specific needs. We can also venture into deeper nearshore waters thanks to our Maverick
